snippet.title: Sonic Nocturnal - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
sonic-nocturnal.carrd.co

Sonic Nocturnal is a Visual Novel RPG.
You're stuck in a world where the night never ends and a dangerous foe controls Eggman's robots and even Sonic's friends.


This game is a non-profit fan-game and is in no way affiliated with SEGA® or Sonic Team™.
All registered trademarks and copyrights belong to SEGA® and Sonic Team™.

Song used for the trailer:
Beautiful ground by nano and Yuyoyuppe

Animation, art and editing - me
